title: Can’t integrate this app with work emails
body: We can’t automatically add tasks from work emails. Outlook.com is not a general work email service across the globe. It’s more of a personal email service. Email services added through Exchange, and the rest etc need to be integrated with this app so we can easily add and follow up on tasks from our work emails otherwise what value add does downloading this app give an iOS user who already has their fabulous Reminders App that comes with the new iOS 14 update? None!! Act sharp and act fast.
author: Sipping on skies
